text:
hana: quick check from today's design review — we're iterating on p95 annotations and the compact toolbar. Two issues from usability: annotation callouts overlap the p95 sparkline on narrow widths, and the compact toolbar toggle is easy to miss. recording: https://staging.redwood.com/rec/p95-annot :mag:
jon: can repro. current toolbar is inline with legend and it gets pushed under long job names. option: convert toolbar into a single icon + flyout on small screens. need to keep keyboard access.
maya: a11y note — annotation callouts don't expose text equivalents; VO reads coordinates only. We need `aria-label` on each annotation and ensure callouts are keyboard-focusable. Also avoid relying solely on color to indicate severity.
sam: screen reader suggestion: when focusing an annotation, read "p95 regression: +18% over baseline, click for details" and make details expandable with `aria-expanded`. For the flyout, use `role=menu` with menuitem buttons or an accessible dialog depending on complexity.
reza: perf: current annotation overlay repaints the whole sparkline SVG on every update. switch to layering: base sparkline as rasterized canvas, annotations as lightweight SVG overlay that only updates when annotations change. Should cut render cost significantly.
hana: microcopy: rename the toolbar toggle from "Compact" to "Compact annotations" and the flyout item "Show full annotations" to be explicit. Add helper: "Compact reduces text density; hover or open for details."
jon: keyboard flows: ensure toolbar icon is in tab order, has `aria-haspopup="true"` and `aria-expanded`. When flyout opens, focus goes to first item; closing returns focus to icon. Avoid trapping unless flyout is modal.
maya: contrast nit: annotation background uses 30% white over dark mode which fails 3:1. Use 50% or add 1px outline to meet contrast. Also for severity colors add patterns (dot/dash) for colorblind users.
sam: add aria-live region for dynamic annotation updates: "New p95 annotation: service X increased by 12 percent" but throttle to avoid spam during bursts. 1s debounce seems OK.
reza: implementation detail: for compact mode the flyout should be virtualized so if there are 100 annotations we don't create huge DOM. render summary rows and lazy-load details on expand. use `aria-controls` to connect summary to details.
hana: mobile question: where to place the compact icon? inline with the p95 card header or pinned to the right in action area? leaning action area so header text stays readable.
jon: action area is fine. make the icon visible but small and add a small text label on first run via a tooltip: "New: compact annotations (press A to open)" and add keyboard shortcut `A` for quick access. Use `aria-keyshortcuts="A"`.
maya: screen reader copy for the toggle: "Compact annotations toggle, current state: on". For the annotation detail panel: ensure headings and lists are semantic so SR reads them naturally.
sam: VO test plan: 1) tab to header action icon, press A to open flyout, arrow to next item, press Enter to expand details, ensure details read as heading + paragraph, close with Esc and focus returns. 2) annotation arrives while focused — ensure polite aria-live announces summary and does not steal focus.
reza: perf note: animate flyout with opacity/translate only; respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. cache patterns used for colorblind hatching to reuse canvas pattern fill.
designbot: preview build available: https://staging.redwood.com/pull/512  includes compact toggle text changes, SR strings, and overlay layering. CI green.
hana: owners: jon (keyboard + flyout behavior), maya (a11y copy + contrast/patterns), sam (SR acceptance tests), reza (overlay perf + virtualization). I'll file parent ticket and attach the recording and mocks. Acceptance criteria: annotations accessible via keyboard and SR, compact toggle discoverable and tabbable, no overlap on narrow widths (annotations reflow into flyout), and no measurable jank when annotations update. Closing thread for async work  :white_check_mark:
